en_title: James Gunn Shuts Down Rumors That Skydance Is Meddling With Man of Tomorrow
cn_title: James Gunn驳斥Skydance干预《Man of Tomorrow》的传闻
opus_summary: 詹姆斯·古恩否认Skydance已观看并大幅修改《Man of Tomorrow》的传闻，称只有彼得·萨夫兰及少数亲友看过影片。古恩还透露，他与萨夫兰最近参与了另一部由他编剧的DC项目。《Man of Tomorrow》计划于2027年7月9日首映。

paragraphs.en: James Gunn has shut down rumors that the new DC overseers at Skydance have meddled with his cut of Man of Tomorrow following his shocking DC Studios exit .
paragraphs.cn: James Gunn令人震惊地离开DC Studios后，有传闻称DC的新管理方Skydance干预了他的《Man of Tomorrow》剪辑版，Gunn驳斥了这一传闻。

paragraphs.en: The internet has filled with gossip in the wake of Gunn and Peter Safran's departure as co-chairmen of the comic book entertainment wing earlier this week. As an ocean of rumors rises, some of the more worrying claims have seen some suggest Skydance has already taken control of the Superman director's sequel, which could result in major characters like Supergirl and Blue Beetle being cut entirely.
paragraphs.cn: 本周早些时候，Gunn和Peter Safran卸任这一漫画娱乐部门的联席主席后，网上充斥着各种传言。随着传闻铺天盖地而来，一些较为令人担忧的说法暗示，Skydance已经接管了这位《Superman》导演的续集，这可能导致超级少女和Blue Beetle等重要角色被彻底删去。

paragraphs.en: These are just some of the accusations that Gunn sought to dispel in a Threads post tonight. In what is essentially his first public statement since leaving DC Studios, the filmmaker took aim at the gossip that has DCU fans concerned. Not only have "sweeping changes" to Man of Tomorrow not been made, but apparently, no one at Skydance has even seen his movie yet.
paragraphs.cn: 这些只是Gunn今晚在Threads的一篇帖子中试图澄清的部分说法。这位电影人在这份实际上是他离开DC Studios后的首度公开声明中，针对令DCU粉丝担忧的传言作出了回应。《Man of Tomorrow》不仅没有被进行「大范围改动」，显然Skydance甚至还没有人看过他的电影。

paragraphs.en: "There are a lot of untrue rumors going around, but one of them is that Skydance has seen Man of Tomorrow and that all sorts of sweeping changes are being made," he said. "No one from Skydance has even seen the movie - the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. So any stories around this narrative are false."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「现在流传着很多不实传闻，其中之一是Skydance已经看过《Man of Tomorrow》，而且正在进行各种大范围改动。Skydance甚至没有人看过这部电影——看过的只有Peter Safran，以及一小群值得信任的朋友和家人。所以围绕这种说法的任何报道都是假的。」

paragraphs.en: It's a response that will not answer every question comic book movie enjoyers have about the future of the DCU, but it does clear the air about much of the more damning chatter online. Gunn's comments mean that any talk of Skydance being unhappy with the current cut of Man of Tomorrow is false. It also sounds like, at least for now, Supergirl and Blue Beetle, who had been previously reported to return, are safe.
paragraphs.cn: 这一回应无法解答漫画电影爱好者对DCU未来的所有疑问，但确实澄清了网上许多更具指责性的传言。Gunn的发言意味着，任何声称Skydance对《Man of Tomorrow》目前剪辑版不满的说法都是假的。听起来，至少目前而言，此前据报道将回归的超级少女和Blue Beetle也是安全的。

paragraphs.en: With so much time left before David Corenswet's Clark Kent returns to theaters in July, though, it's hard to say how the Skydance takeover may impact its release. It's best to wait until Gunn or Skydance has more to share before setting any firm expectations in place for now.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，距离大卫·科伦斯韦饰演的Clark Kent在7月重返影院还有很长时间，很难说Skydance的接管可能会如何影响这部电影的上映。目前最好等到Gunn或Skydance透露更多消息后，再形成任何明确预期。

paragraphs.en: All of that said, it's not too hard to see why fans of the DCU have felt uneasy in the last few days. Gunn and Safran have orchestrated the DCU to tell a varied collection of superpowered stories for four years, with its overarching plan for the years ahead only just starting to come into view. Pulling them from the driver's seat means the future is more unknown than ever before, especially considering Skydance was quick to find a replacement in Marvel alum Jeremy Latcham.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，不难理解DCU粉丝为何在过去几天感到不安。四年来，Gunn和Safran一直在统筹DCU，讲述各种各样的超能力故事，其未来数年的整体计划也才刚刚开始显现。让他们离开掌舵位置意味着未来比以往任何时候都更加未知，尤其是考虑到Skydance很快找来了曾在Marvel任职的Jeremy Latcham接替他们。

paragraphs.en: Will Man of Tomorrow be altered against Gunn's will? Will Skydance reboot the DC movie universe and scrap future plans for the DCU? How will any of this affect future entries in Robert Pattinson's The Batman saga? It's all too soon to tell, but that won't stop the rumor mill from pushing ahead.
paragraphs.cn: 《Man of Tomorrow》会在违背Gunn意愿的情况下被修改吗？Skydance会重启DC电影宇宙并放弃DCU的未来计划吗？这一切又会如何影响罗伯特·帕丁森主演的《新蝙蝠侠》系列未来的作品？现在下结论还为时过早，但这不会阻止传闻继续流传。

paragraphs.en: What we do know is what Gunn shared with fans in the immediate aftermath of his exit. In a letter posted to social media , he promised that the characters he and Safran helped set up "will live on." He also confirmed that the duo was recently "engaged on another DC project" that he is writing. What that project is remains a mystery.
paragraphs.cn: 我们确实知道的，是Gunn在离职后不久与粉丝分享的内容。在一封发布于社交媒体的信中，他承诺，他和Safran帮助塑造的角色「将继续存在」。他还证实，两人最近「参与了另一个DC项目」，该项目由他编写。这个项目究竟是什么仍是个谜。

paragraphs.en: For more on the future of the DCU, you can read up on what we know about Latcham . You can also check out another report that suggested Skydance intends to prioritize more well-known heroes in the DC portfolio going forward . Man of Tomorrow, meanwhile, is set to premiere July 9, 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 有关DCU未来的更多信息，你可以了解我们所知道的关于Latcham的情况。你也可以查看另一篇报道，该报道称Skydance今后打算优先考虑DC旗下更知名的英雄。与此同时，《Man of Tomorrow》定于2027年7月9日首映。
